newsitem.title: UK: J.P. Morgan prices $925 mln asset-backed FRN.
newsitem.headline: J.P. Morgan prices $925 mln asset-backed FRN.

text.p: MBNA Master Credit Card Series 1996-J has priced its asset-backed FRN for a total of $925 million, lead manager J.P. Morgan Securities said.
Tranche A totals $850 million, has an issue and reoffer price of par and a coupon of one-month Libor plus 15 basis points.
Tranche B is for a total of $75 million. It has an issue and reoffer price of par and a coupon of 36 b.p. over one-month Libor.
Both have a legal maturity of February 15 2006, with an expected maturity of September 15 2003.
The bonds are listed in Luxembourg. Fees total 35 b.p. and the pay date is September 19.
